content: Individuals who present with symptoms such as claudication (pain in the legs or arms during physical activity due to inadequate blood flow) or rest pain (persistent pain in the extremities even at rest) should undergo screening for peripheral arterial disease (PAD). This screening should be conducted using diagnostic methods such as Doppler ultrasound, which evaluates blood flow in the vessels, or the ankle-brachial index (ABI), a non-invasive test that compares blood pressure in the ankle to blood pressure in the arm to assess for arterial blockages or narrowing.
